scope_guards: LBBD57 retains blank minimum and maximum dwelling capacity rather than importing 56 homes.
The structured not-permissioned status is not overwritten by evidence about a separately described development.
The 56-home former-library/junction project is not assigned to the garages record without exact polygon overlap.
Thirty-nine Affordable Rent and seventeen London Affordable Rent homes are tenure subsets of 56, not additional capacity.
The 2023 variation changes tenure mix and does not create another 56 homes.
Delegated authority subject to a unilateral undertaking is retained as chronology and not used as exact parcel topology.
Expected June 2024 completion and long-lease arrangements are not exact completion-date or proprietor evidence for LBBD57.
No promotion is written until exact current geometry, HMLR relation, permission binding and overlays are verified.
